SELECT 
  s.entrystat,
  AVG(se.ambictemp) as avg_ambictemp,
  AVG(se.imgcount) as avg_imgcount,
  AVG(se.imgcount) - (
    SELECT AVG(status_avg)
    FROM (
      SELECT AVG(se2.imgcount) as status_avg
      FROM scanenvironment se2
      INNER JOIN sites s2 ON se2.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry
      GROUP BY s2.entrystat
    )
  ) as img_avg_diff
FROM scanenvironment se
INNER JOIN sites s ON se.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.entrystat
